display.purpose: The name only; per-letter pointer reaction from wght 640 / wdth 92 toward wght 800 / wdth 78.

hook.purpose: The one sentence under the name; muted, one ink word underlined in accent; max 30ch.

title.purpose: Work item names; article h2 at 640 / 1.375rem is its sibling.

section.purpose: Section headings followed by a hairline to the column edge.

body.purpose: Running text; 54-58ch for descriptions, 68ch for article prose.

label.purpose: Dates, status, tags, footer, terminal. Data only.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default for every transition (180-420ms), reveals (640ms, 14px rise, 70ms stagger), and the theme view-transition reveal.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Small user-triggered moments only: poke bubble, name letter reaction, copy check, cookie icon.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: transition-property: opacity, color, background-color, border-color; animation 1ms
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion collapses movement to colour and opacity.

breakpoints.name: stack
breakpoints.purpose: Timeline and stack label column collapses to one column.

breakpoints.name: touch
breakpoints.purpose: Floating preview disabled; preview renders inline in the opened row.

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Quiet underlined link; underline and text turn accent on hover, arrow nudges.
components.html: See work
components.css: .ds-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35em; color: var(--ink, #1c1a17); font-weight: 540; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--rule, #e0d9cc); text-decoration-thickness: 1.5px; text-underline-offset: 0.28em; transition: color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), text-decoration-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-link svg { transition: transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-link:hover { color: var(--accent, #1d6a9e); text-decoration-color: currentColor; } .ds-link:hover svg { transform: translateY(2px); } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #1d6a9e); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 3px; }

components.name: Copy Email
components.description: The only button-like control: outlined hairline pill, no fill; accent border when copied.
components.css: .ds-copy { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.65rem; padding: 0.85rem 1.1rem; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #1c1a17); border: 1px solid var(--rule, #e0d9cc); border-radius: 999px; font: inherit; font-weight: 540; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-copy svg { color: var(--muted, #6b645b); } .ds-copy:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #1c1a17); } .ds-copy:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-copy:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #1d6a9e); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Work Row
components.description: Ruled list row: title, muted line, mono tags, plus icon that rotates when open.
components.css: .ds-work { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-work-row { border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #e0d9cc); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #e0d9cc); } .ds-work-toggle { all: unset; box-sizing: border-box; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; column-gap: 1.25rem; width: 100%; padding: 1.25rem 0 1.3rem; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; } .ds-work-name { font-size: 1.3125rem; line-height: 1.25; font-weight: 620; letter-spacing: -0.015em; color: var(--ink, #1c1a17); display: inline-flex; gap: 0.75rem; align-items: baseline; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-work-note { color: var(--muted, #6b645b); font-weight: 400; } .ds-work-icon { grid-row: 1; grid-column: 2; align-self: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--muted, #6b645b); transition: transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 200ms; } .ds-work-line { grid-column: 1; margin-top: 0.3rem; color: var(--muted, #6b645b); max-width: 54ch; } .ds-work-tags { grid-column: 1; margin-top: 0.6rem; color: var(--muted, #6b645b); font-family: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.8125rem; } .ds-work-toggle:hover .ds-work-name { color: var(--accent, #1d6a9e); transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-work-toggle:hover .ds-work-icon { color: var(--ink, #1c1a17); } .ds-work-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #1d6a9e); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Preview Frame
components.description: 16:10 paper frame with a 1px inset ink outline; illustrations carry a mono label.
components.css: .ds-frame { position: relative; width: 300px; aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--paper, #f6f2ea); outline: 1px solid var(--ink, #1c1a17); outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-frame-label { position: absolute; right: 8px; bottom: 6px; padding: 0 2px; background: var(--paper, #f6f2ea); font-family: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.6875rem; color: var(--muted, #6b645b); }

components.name: Section Title
components.description: Narrow-width heavy heading with a hairline running to the column edge.
components.css: .ds-section-title { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; margin: 0; font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 660; letter-spacing: -0.005em; font-variation-settings: "opsz" 24, "wdth" 86; color: var(--ink, #1c1a17); } .ds-section-title::after { content: ""; flex: 1; height: 1px; background: var(--rule, #e0d9cc); }

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.description: 44px circular icon button; wash ground on hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-toggle" type="button" aria-label="Toggle theme"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4.5"/><path d="M12 2.5v2M12 19.5v2M2.5 12h2M19.5 12h2M5.3 5.3l1.4 1.4M17.3 17.3l1.4 1.4M5.3 18.7l1.4-1.4M17.3 6.7l1.4-1.4"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-toggle { all: unset; width: 44px; height: 44px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer; color: var(--ink, #1c1a17); transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-toggle:hover { background: var(--wash, #ede7dc); } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #1d6a9e); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Terminal
components.description: Easter-egg dialog: paper ground, 1px ink border, mono body, accent prompt.
components.html:
~/hussain
$ whoami
full-stack + AI, browser to microcontroller
components.css: .ds-term { width: 420px; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #1c1a17); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--paper, #f6f2ea); color: var(--ink, #1c1a17); overflow: hidden; font-family: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.8125rem; } .ds-term-bar { padding: 0.6rem 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #e0d9cc); color: var(--muted, #6b645b); } .ds-term-body { padding: 1rem; line-height: 1.65; } .ds-prompt { color: var(--accent, #1d6a9e); margin-right: 0.6rem; } .ds-out { color: var(--muted, #6b645b); }

components.name: Poke Bubble
components.description: Speech bubble from the portrait tap: paper, 1px ink border, tail corner, spring entry.
components.css: .ds-bubble { display: inline-block; padding: 0.3rem 0.65rem; background: var(--paper, #f6f2ea); color: var(--ink, #1c1a17); border: 1px solid var(--ink, #1c1a17); border-radius: 10px 10px 10px 2px; font-family: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.75rem; white-space: nowrap; transform-origin: 0 100%; animation: ds-bubble-in 320ms cubic-bezier(0.34,1.3,0.64,1) both; } @keyframes ds-bubble-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.6) translateY(6px); } }

narrative.overview:
A calm personal page on one narrow axis. The person appears as a 1-bit ordered-dither portrait whose dots are the exact ink of the type, on warm paper by day and graphite by night. Everything else is typography and hairlines: Bricolage Grotesque does the expressive work through its weight, width and optical-size axes, and JetBrains Mono appears only where data lives (dates, status, tags, the terminal).

Density is low and the reading order is linear: one centered first viewport, then ruled lists separated by generous section padding. Depth comes from 1px lines, never from lifted surfaces. Colour is near-monochrome; one rare accent arrives on hover, on the hook's single emphasised word, on focus rings and inside the easter eggs.

The world rejects the stacked-section portfolio template: hero banners, card grids, tech-logo walls, filled "Hire Me" buttons.
keyCharacteristics: One ink for type, icons and portrait dots; paper or graphite ground.
Hairline rules (1px) are the only structure.
Variable-axis type: width and weight move, the family never changes.
Square dots as the recurring mark (portrait cells, status pulse, list bullets, favicon).
One accent at a time, chosen site-wide (blue, marigold or olive).
Motion is ease-out and quiet; overshoot only on small things the visitor triggered.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Type, icons and portrait dots share one colour token. The portrait is never a photo-tone image; it is ink on paper.

rules.name: The Rare Accent Rule
rules.body: The accent marks state and a single emphasised word. It never fills a surface larger than the 6px status square.

rules.name: The Axis Not Family Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy and expression come from weight, width and optical size of the one grotesque. Do not add a second display family.

rules.name: The Mono Means Data Rule
rules.body: Mono is reserved for dates, status, tags, labels and the terminal. Never set prose or headings in it.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 1px lines: rule-coloured between content, ink-coloured around objects that float. No drop shadows, no filled cards, no filled chips.

rules.name: The Square Dot Rule
rules.body: Any small mark (bullet, status, indicator) is a square in ink or accent, echoing the dither cell. No round dots, no glyph bullets.

dos: Do draw every separation with a 1px line: rule colour between content, ink around floating objects.
Do keep the accent to hover, focus, state, the hook's single word and the easter eggs, and read it from `--accent` so the site-wide accent choice applies.
Do express hierarchy through Bricolage's weight, width and optical-size axes.
Do use JetBrains Mono at 0.8125rem with tabular numerals for dates, status and tags.
Do use `--ease-out` (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) for transitions, 180 to 420ms; reveals rise 14px over 640ms with 70ms staggers.
Do reserve `--ease-spring` (cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.3, 0.64, 1)) for small moments the visitor triggered: the poke bubble, letter reactions, the copy check, the cookie icon.
Do label illustrative previews as illustrations; real screenshots only where they exist.
Do honour reduced motion: transitions collapse to colour and opacity, reveals do not move.
donts: Don't use drop shadows or any box-shadow elevation.
Don't use filled cards, filled chips or filled pills; the wash ground is only for icon-button hover and code blocks.
Don't combine accents or introduce a fourth one.
Don't render the portrait in tones or colours other than the current ink.
Don't use overshoot easing on scroll reveals, layout changes or anything that moves without the visitor's input.
Don't add a second display family or set headings in mono.
Don't use round dots or glyph characters as bullets and indicators; use the square mark.
